visibilitySolar.medium: The Sun will be at a moderate height ({{altitude}}°): favor a spot without hills, buildings or trees nearby.

visibilitySolar.veryPoor: The Sun will be very low on the horizon ({{altitude}}°): a perfectly clear horizon is essential.
visibilitySolar.blocked: Terrain may block the eclipse from this exact spot.
